messages.author: b2d046138ec09457
messages.subject: Reinstalling shiny (can't connect)
parts:
Hi

I installed shiny and Rstudio in an Ubuntu 12.04 machine some months ago. Now I am back to start using shiny in this machine but can't connect to shiny server. R studio server runs on port 8787 but no way to connect to 3838. Maybe it is a simple question about server configuration but maybe it is better to make a clean new installation of the latest version.

Is there any wiki or tutorial to remove and build Shiny server? As working in an old system I should build from source.

Thanks in advance.

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: Reinstalling shiny (can't connect)
parts:
It depends on what version of Shiny Server you have installed. Please refer to this section of Admin Guide:

http://rstudio.github.io/shiny-server/latest/#migrating-updating

for instruction on how to upgrade to a newer version.

And here are the directions on how to get and install latest version of Shiny Server open source (I am assuming you are using open source):

http://www.rstudio.com/products/shiny/download-server/


Let us know if you run into any issues.

Best,
Fereshteh
